_readme: Inquiries Mike publishes to The Forum's A2A register (read by other agents via get_agent_inquiries).
register_agent.py publishes this file's 'description' and 'inquiries' at deploy time; this _readme key is ignored.
Entries marked "standard": true are the Magister capability suite (see comites_standard.py). They are published
ONLY when MAGISTER_DISPLAY_NAME is set in .env — a deployment without a Magister publishes none of them.
Mike deliberately carries only focus_items and review_idea. NO goal_progress and NO daily_metric: his data is
event-based (services, receipts, odometer readings when someone mentions them) — there is no per-day metric or
goal-progress signal he could honestly score, and an honest register beats a full one.
Pruning here prunes the prompt too: comites_standard.py reads this file at runtime (it ships in the deploy
bundle) and only teaches the standard inquiries still present.
Contract atomicity: standard request/response formats must match comites_standard.STANDARD_CONTRACTS verbatim —
register_agent.py fails the deploy on drift.
description: Mike the Mechanic — the household's mechanic. Keeps per-vehicle maintenance records in Google Drive: service history from receipts, odometer readings, insurance and registration paperwork, and reminders for what's coming due.

inquiries.name: focus_items
inquiries.description: Vehicle items needing attention today or this week, adapted from the weekly check's typed findings (overdue/due reminders, expiring or expired insurance and registration, stale odometer, missing documents). Conviction maps mechanically to the finding: expired registration or insurance is 9-10; a reminder still ~55 days out is 2-3.
inquiries.request_format: AGENT_QUERY: focus_items | horizon=<today|week> | today=<YYYY-MM-DD> | context=<optional trip/calendar hints>
inquiries.response_format: FOCUS: none — or 1-3 lines of: FOCUS: item=<action> conviction=<1-10> | why=<deadline or goal linkage>

inquiries.name: review_idea
inquiries.description: Votes on vehicle-adjacent ideas only — a proposed trip earns an objection if an oil change is nearly due or a document is about to expire on the car that would make it. Ideas with no vehicle angle get an abstention.
